drafter.private_reasoning: The draft lacks essential payment terms and an adequate definition of the released claims. Preserve client confidentiality, limit the release to the underlying dispute, and flag unresolved terms rather than imply client approval.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Please find proposed revisions clarifying payment mechanics, tying the release to receipt of funds, and adding customary confidentiality exceptions. The amount, payment deadline, and description of the underlying dispute remain bracketed for agreement. These revisions are subject to client review and approval.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising out of [identify the underlying dispute and any pending action] (the “Dispute”), on the terms below. The “Effective Date” is the date on which the last party signs this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency] (the “Settlement Amount”) within [number] business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Payment instructions shall be independently verified before transmission.

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to unrelated claims, claims arising from subsequent acts or omissions, or rights to enforce this Agreement. Any dismissal of a pending action, including its timing and allocation of costs, shall be specified in [agreed dismissal provisions].

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures to their legal, tax, and financial advisers who are subject to confidentiality obligations; disclosures required by law, regulation, subpoena, or court order; and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. For compelled disclosures, the disclosing party shall, to the extent legally permitted and practicable, give the other party advance notice and disclose only what is required. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful communications with, or cooperation in an investigation by, a governmental authority.
4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement is a compromise of disputed claims. Neither this Agreement nor payment under it constitutes an admission of liability or wrongdoing by either party.

receiver.message_back: The payment verification, release-on-receipt, and confidentiality provisions provide a workable basis, subject to our client’s approval of the complete agreement; please provide your client’s proposed settlement amount and payment deadline so we can assess the package. We also require precise identification of the Dispute, agreed dismissal timing and cost allocation, and clear remedies for nonpayment before finalizing terms.

drafter.private_reasoning: The record supplies neither an authorized settlement amount nor facts identifying the Dispute. Those items must remain open pending client instructions. The proposed deadlines, dismissal mechanics, and nonpayment remedies below are negotiation proposals subject to client approval. No confidential client information is included in the outgoing text.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: We attach proposed revisions addressing payment timing, dismissal, costs, and nonpayment. Subject to our client’s approval, we propose payment within ten business days after execution, followed by dismissal with prejudice within five business days after receipt of cleared funds, with each party bearing its own fees and costs in the Dispute. For nonpayment, we propose written notice and a five-business-day cure period, after which Plaintiff may enforce the payment obligation or terminate and pursue the underlying claims, without double recovery. We are obtaining instructions on the settlement amount and cannot yet provide an authorized figure. Please confirm the underlying facts and any action caption, court, and case number for the recital. All proposals remain subject to agreement on the complete document and client approval; the bracketed items must be completed before execution.

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve only the claims arising out of [insert agreed description of the transaction or events, relevant dates, and claims, and identify any pending action by full caption, court, and case number] (the “Dispute”), on the terms below. The “Effective Date” is the date on which the last party signs this Agreement.

1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [amount and currency—to be agreed before execution] (the “Settlement Amount”) within ten business days after the Effective Date, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall provide payment instructions promptly after the Effective Date. Payment instructions shall be independently verified before transmission. If Plaintiff delays providing instructions or reasonably necessary verification, the payment deadline shall be extended only to the extent that delay prevents timely payment. For this Agreement, “business day” means a day other than Saturday, Sunday, or a U.S. federal holiday. If Defendant fails to make timely payment, Plaintiff shall give written notice of nonpayment and allow five business days after Defendant’s receipt of that notice to cure. If full payment remains outstanding after that period, Plaintiff may elect by written notice either to enforce the unpaid payment obligation or to terminate this Agreement and pursue the underlying claims. No release becomes effective before receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds. Any partial payments shall be credited against any recovery, and Plaintiff shall not obtain double recovery. Termination does not affect the confidentiality or no-admission provisions.

2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the Effective Date. This release does not extend to unrelated claims, claims arising from subsequent acts or omissions, or rights to enforce this Agreement. Within five business days after that receipt, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal with prejudice of the claims constituting the Dispute in the action identified in the Recitals, and Defendant shall cooperate in executing any required stipulation. Neither party is required to dismiss claims before full payment is received. Each party shall bear its own attorneys’ fees and costs incurred in the Dispute and in negotiating this Agreement. This Agreement creates no independent entitlement to attorneys’ fees in an enforcement proceeding.
